name: cellcell-compete
description: Two competitor CPM cells (CpmColonyField) share one 60x60 glucose field and race for the same nutrient via independent per-cell dFBA. Both cells run the microaerobic e_coli_core role ('competitor'): dynamic MM-limited glucose uptake capped by their own glucose_vmax (10.0 for the left/fast competitor, 4.0 for the right/slow competitor), O2 capped to force mixed-acid acetate overflow, exactly like the flagship single-cell loop. Seeded left/right in non-overlapping half-open seed_blocks over a uniform ~3.0 mM glucose field so early dynamics aren't gradient-biased -- any asymmetry in growth traces back to the vmax difference, not seed position. Acetate is tracked as the shared byproduct field (diffuses away, not consumed by either competitor). Structural build target for task 3; regime tuning / competitive-exclusion assertions are task 4.
